function DesktopWidgetManager:checkPopAct(today)
    if not self:isActEnabled() or self:checkMainPanelVM() then return end
    today = today or time2day(TimeKit:timeInSec())
    local model = self:getModel()

    local guideKey = self:getConst().GuideKey
    local guideId = self:getConst().GuideId

    local canPop
    if not self:hasGuideIndex(guideId.TRIGGER)then
        local trigger = self:checkTrigger()
        if trigger then
            self:addGuideIndex(guideId.TRIGGER)
        else
            canPop = guideId.TRIGGER
        end
    end

    -- 第二、三天未安装且未点击，强弹
    if not canPop and not self:isWidgetInstall()
        and not model:checkGuide(guideKey.DAILY_PANEL_OPEN, today) then
        local triggerDay = time2day(model:getTriggerTime())
        local delta = today - triggerDay
        if delta == 1 or delta == 2 and not self:hasGuideIndex(delta + 1) then
            canPop = delta + 1
        end
    end

    -- 当日有奖
    if not canPop and not model:checkGuide(guideKey.DAILY_PANEL_REWARD, today) then
        local todayIndex = self:checkHaveEnterFromWidget()
        if not todayIndex then
            todayIndex = self._launchFromWidget and (model:getLoginTimeListFromWidgetLength() + 1)
        end
        if todayIndex and not table.indexOf(self:getModel():getHasGetRewardList(), todayIndex)
            and not self:hasGuideIndex(todayIndex + 10) then
            canPop = todayIndex + 10
        end
    end
    if not canPop then return end

    local function onHandleOver()
		AutoPopEventCenter:dispatch(AutoPopEvent.SINGLE_POP_OVER, PopupCheckPoint.WIDGET_REWARD_ACT)
	end

	local function creator()
        self:addGuideIndex(canPop)

        self:callActFunc("openActivity", {
            failCallback = onHandleOver,
            endCallback = onHandleOver,
            extra = {
                from = 3
            },
            userClick = true,
        })
	end
    self._autoPopupMgr:addPopupConfig(PopupCheckPoint.WIDGET_REWARD_ACT, creator)
    return true
end

        stages = {AutoPopupConst.PopStage.STAGE_FOUR},
        check = function()
            -- isEnabled 已包含 isDataEnabled 与活动时间窗（主时间/领奖期）。
            if not self:isActivitySupported(self:getConst().actId) then return false end
            if not self:isEnabled() then return false end
            if _G.getTopLevelId() < 101 then return false end
            -- R1/R2/R3 分组互斥（由 isNewVersion 与 magic_1v1_pop 开关决定）。
            -- R1：每日最多弹出 1 次；R2：不限制；R3：新版本流程。
            if rule == "R1" then
                return not self:getDailyPopupFlag()
                    and self:isInPrepare()
                    and not self:shouldReduceAutoPopup()
            end
            if rule == "R3" then
                -- 每日主面板未弹过则弹；已弹过仅展示获胜结算。
                if not self:getDailyPopupFlag() then
                    return not self:shouldReduceAutoPopup()
                end
                if self:isToBeSettledNormal() then
                    local myScore, enemyScore = self:getMatchScore()
                    return self:checkWinState(myScore, enemyScore) == self:getConst().MatchState.WIN
                end
                return false
            end
            -- R2：不限制次数
            return self:isInPrepare() and not self:shouldReduceAutoPopup()
        end,
        pop = function(_, onPopOver)
            return function()
                -- R1 弹出即落当日标记，供 check 拦截同日再次弹出。
                if rule == "R1" then
                    self:setDailyPopupFlag()
                end
                self:openActivity({
                    failCallback = onPopOver,
                    endCallback = onPopOver,
                })
            end
        end,
    })
    self._autoPopRegistered = true
end

    local contentId = FeedContext.getTrialSourceIdFromJS()
    --
--
--
--
--
--


    if not FeedRevisitConfig.isOfflineReward(contentId) then
        -- 未命中本次投放方案，交回默认复访流程
        return false
    end

    local fruitTreeManager = _G.amfBean("FruitTreeManager")
    if not fruitTreeManager or not fruitTreeManager:isEnabled() then
        -- 果树未开放（未过 FruitTreeConst.OPAN_PASSLEVEL）等异常数据：不展示果树面板，
        -- 补一次兜底上报（保持本轮场景上报不丢），再交回默认复访流程
        self:reportFeedRevisitScene()
        return false
    end

    local guide

    local function hideGuide()
        local guideNode = guide
        guide = nil
        if guideNode and not guideNode.isDisposed then
            guideNode:removeGuide()
        end
    end

    local function showGuide()
        hideGuide()
        local HeGuide = require "amf.middleware.ui.kit.component.HeGuide"
        guide = HeGuide:create(nil, true, nil, nil, true)
        guide:setEndCall(function()
            hideGuide()
        end)
        guide:showNpc2({
            { ttf = FeedRevisitConfig.OfflineRewardTipText },
        }, FEED_REVISIT_OFFLINE_GUIDE_POS_Y)
        guide:setMaskOpacity(0)
    end

    local function creator()
        local popupOver = false
        local function finishPopup()
            if popupOver then return end
            popupOver = true
            hideGuide()
            FeedContext.clearRevisitContext()
            self._autoPopupMgr:resetPopup()
            -- 关闭果树面板后的去向：当前保持主场景，不额外拉起开始面板（待产品确认）
        end

        fruitTreeManager:openFruitTreePanel({
            t1 = "feed_revisit_offline",
            onOpened = function()
                showGuide()
                self:reportFeedRevisitScene()
            end,
            onClosed = finishPopup,
            onLoadFailed = finishPopup,
        })
    end
    self._autoPopupMgr:addPopupConfig(PopupCheckPoint.DY_MINI_OPEN_START_PANEL, creator)
    return true

function CrashResumeHandler:handleMainAndHide(params)
	local crashResumeLogic = params.logic
	if not crashResumeLogic then return end

	local bGetOtherContextSucess = params.bGetOtherContextSucess
	local otherDevicePlayingContextInfo = params.otherDevicePlayingContextInfo

	local function onHandleOver()
		self:clearOthers(PopupCheckPoint.CRASH_RESUME_MAIN)
        AutoPopEventCenter:dispatch(AutoPopEvent.SINGLE_POP_OVER , PopupCheckPoint.CRASH_RESUME_MAIN)
    end

    local function creator()
    	local AsyncRunner = require "amf.script.sugar.AsyncRunner"

		local function onResp(canResume, errCode)
			local cantResumeParams
			if not canResume then
				cantResumeParams = crashResumeLogic:getLastResumeFailData()
			end

			local asyncRunner = AsyncRunner:create()

			asyncRunner:add(function (done)
				if _G.amfBean("ActivityMgr"):checkActInfoInited() then
					safeRunCall(done)
				else
					--等1秒，活动信息回来
					setTimeOut( done, 1 )
				end
			end)

			if bGetOtherContextSucess then
				asyncRunner:add(function (done)
					--处理别的设备打关弹板
					self:handleBeforeMainAndHide( otherDevicePlayingContextInfo, done )
				end)
			end

			if canResume then
				asyncRunner:add(function (done)
					--闪退恢复
					crashResumeLogic:handleMiniGameResume():next(function (resumed)
						if resumed then
							self._autoPopupMgr:resetPopup()
						else
							safeRunCall(done)
						end
					end)
				end)
			else
				asyncRunner:add(function (done)
					--闪退不能恢复
					--尝试弹出连胜不能恢复面板
					if cantResumeParams and errCode and errCode == UBFGameResumeFailReason.kCrashOver1Hour then
						self:handleMainAndHideFail({_data = cantResumeParams}, done)
					else
						safeRunCall(done)
					end
				end)
			end

			asyncRunner:add(function (done)
				safeRunCall(onHandleOver)
			end)

			asyncRunner:run()
		end
		crashResumeLogic:checkCanResume(onResp)

    end
    self._autoPopupMgr:addPopupConfig(PopupCheckPoint.CRASH_RESUME_MAIN, creator)
end

				elseif count == 2 then

		end
	end

	do

function PopupRegistration:_enqueueRegisteredPopup(candidate)
    local entry = candidate.entry
    local config = entry.config
    local checkPoint = entry.checkPoint
	local function onPopOver()
		AutoPopEventCenter:dispatch(
			AutoPopEvent.SINGLE_POP_OVER,
			checkPoint
		)
    end

    local pop = config.pop or config.creator
    local ok, creator = pcall(pop, candidate.stageParams, onPopOver)
    if not ok or type(creator) ~= "function" then
        AutoPopupDebugLog:log("PopupRegistration:creator error", entry.checkPoint, tostring(creator))
        AutoPopupDebugLog:recordPopupEnqueue({
            checkPoint = checkPoint,
            actId = config.actId,
            source = "registered",
        }, "fail", LogReason.Enqueue.CREATOR_ERROR, checkPoint)
        return
    end

    local enqueued = self._autoPopupMgr:addPopupConfig(
        checkPoint, creator, config.actId, "registered"
    )
    if enqueued and candidate.stageParams then
        local popupQueue = self._autoPopupMgr:getPopupQueueByCheckPoint(checkPoint)
        local popupEntry = popupQueue and popupQueue[checkPoint]
        if popupEntry then
            popupEntry.popupStageId = candidate.stageParams.popStage
        end
    end
    return enqueued
end

		AutoPopEventCenter:dispatch(AutoPopEvent.SINGLE_POP_OVER, PopupCheckPoint.SUB_MSG)
	end

	local function creator()
		self:showDailyRewardPanel():next(function()
			onHandleOver()
		end)
	end
	self._autoPopupMgr:addPopupConfig(PopupCheckPoint.SUB_MSG, creator)
end

-- 过关检查是否要开启

function WideScreenLogic:tryAddPop()
    if not self:isEnabled() or self:hasPopped() then return end

    local key = PopupCheckPoint.WIDE_SCREEN_ADVICE

    local function onHandleOver()
        AutoPopEventCenter:dispatch(AutoPopEvent.SINGLE_POP_OVER, key)
    end

    local creator = function ( ... )
        if not self:isEnabled() then
            onHandleOver()
            return
        end
        _G.amfBean("AutoPopupMgr"):sendPermanentData(key)
        self:openNoticePanel(onHandleOver)
    end

    _G.amfBean("AutoPopupMgr"):addPopupConfig(key, creator)
end
